.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:37:/-- The Taylor expansion of a polynomial `f` at `r`. -/
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:38:def taylor (r : R) : R[X] →ₗ[R] R[X] where
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:43:theorem taylor_apply : taylor r f = f.comp (X + C r) :=
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:47:theorem taylor_X : taylor r X = X + C r := X_comp
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:50:theorem taylor_X_pow (n : ℕ) : taylor r (X ^ n) = (X + C r) ^ n := X_pow_comp
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:53:theorem taylor_C (x : R) : taylor r (C x) = C x := C_comp
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:55:theorem taylor_zero (f : R[X]) : taylor 0 f = f := by rw [taylor_apply, C_0, add_zero, comp_X]
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:58:theorem taylor_zero' : taylor (0 : R) = LinearMap.id := LinearMap.ext taylor_zero
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:61:theorem taylor_one : taylor r (1 : R[X]) = C 1 := taylor_C r 1
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:64:theorem taylor_monomial (i : ℕ) (k : R) : taylor r (monomial i k) = C k * (X + C r) ^ i := by
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:65:  simp [taylor_apply]
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean:67:/-- The `k`th coefficient of `Polynomial.taylor r f` is `(Polynomial.hasseDeriv k f).eval r`. -/
